note.farmTable.title: A note on the crate
lines: Three plates on an upturned crate. Dusty.
Scratched on a board: GONE TO THE OUTWALL.
BACK BY SPRING. DO NOT LET THE FIRE DIE.

note.towerScratch.title: Marks by the tower door
lines: Claw marks, low and fresh. Two sizes.
Something small, and something smaller.
They dig at the door from the inside.

note.strand.monster.title: A sign on the Long Strand
lines: Carved in a driftwood post, worn salt-white:
SWIM TO THE STAKES. NOT ONE STROKE PAST.
Under it, newer, in charcoal: IT CIRCLES FIRST.

note.knot.title: A knot on the brass
lines: A skyworks hitch. Lamp-trimmers tie it.
Pulled tight. Weathered grey. Years old.

note.sealedGate.title: A gate across the pass
lines: Iron bars. A lock the size of a fist.
The keyhole is clean. No rust in it.
Someone still keeps a key.
note.sealedGate.hint: Locked. The bars do not even rattle.

note.sealedGate.again.title: A gate across the pass
lines: Oil on the hinges. Fresh this season.
Whoever keeps the key keeps the gate.

inspect.wagon.title: A cart off the road
lines: Tipped on its side. The axle snapped clean.
Crates split open. Straw gone grey. Nothing in them.
The ruts run east, toward the Wall.
Nobody came back for it.

note.westRuin.title: A gatehouse wall
lines: Tally marks, forty or fifty, then a gap.
Under them, scratched deep: NOT ALL OF US WENT NORTH.
Whoever wrote it meant to come back.

note.westMeadow.title: A cart in the grass
lines: Tall grass, and deep hoof prints all round.
The boars were here before you came.

note.westStones.title: A ring of stones
lines: Six stones, set on the hill by hand.
You can see the ford and the trade post from here.
Whoever stood here watched the road.

note.cemetery.crypt.title: The crypt door
lines: The crypt door is sealed.
Something scratches inside.

note.crypt.walls.title: The crypt wall
lines: Old brick, black with smoke. Names cut in rows.
Every name scraped off. Someone did not want them read.

note.crypt.coffin.title: A coffin
lines: The lid is pushed aside. From the inside.
Dust and dry earth. Nothing lies in it now.

note.crypt.banner.title: An old banner
lines: A rotted banner. Under the dirt: a tower and a light.
The light is stitched in thread that is still teal.

note.crypt.chest.title: A sealed chest
lines: Iron bands and a grey wax seal. Shut tight.
It will not open while the dead still walk here.

note.poi.whitecombs.1.title: A ring of stones
lines: Set upright by hand, long ago.
The grass inside is still short.

note.poi.whitecombs.2.title: A broken arch
lines: Someone scratched tally marks on the stone.
Forty-one, and then they stop.

note.poi.westFells.2.title: A ring of stones

note.poi.westFells.3.title: A wrecked wagon
lines: The wheels are gone and the bed is split.
A faded cross is chalked on the tailboard.

inspect.well.title: A dry well
lines: Planks across the mouth. One brick gone.
You drop a pebble. No splash. No echo.
The bucket rope was cut, not rotted.
Someone did not want it used again.
Cold light rises from the dry well.

inspect.shrine.title: A fallen shrine
lines: A stone niche on its back. The pillar leans west.
Three rings cut in the base, worn soft.
The same mark as the waystones.
In the niche, a cup of rainwater. Fresh.
The base is scraped from below. It was pushed.

inspect.woodpile.title: A woodcutter's stack
lines: Split logs, stacked bark-up against the rain.
Grey with age. Moss along the top row.
A tally cut in the end post stops mid-row.
Ash on the top logs. Blown from the tower.

inspect.gateLamp.title: Lanterns at the gate
lines: Floor lanterns, set in a row. Burning.
Out here, at the far end of the road.
Someone wants this gate found.

inspect.roadLamp.title: A lamp on a crate
lines: Brass, set on an old crate by the road.
It is lit. Nobody comes to light it.
The oil never seems to go down.

inspect.tradeLamp.title: A lamp on the counter
lines: Brass, on the trade post counter. Lit.
The flame is trimmed low and even.
Skyworks neat. Out here.

inspect.nest.empty.title: A crow's nest
lines: Sticks, wire, a bootlace, a bent spoon.
A round hollow where the glass sat.
Someone has already counted what is left.

note.fordCellar.note: Writer 2026-10-15 (UNDER-03): smugglers' cellar tally; pairs with note.smugglers (graves run stopped, someone else goes there). No names.
note.fordCellar.title: A tally on a cellar beam
lines: Salt, six sacks. Oil, four jars. All from the strand.
Up the stairs by night. Never past the post lamp.
The graves run is off. Nobody carries there now.
Whoever goes down there, it is not one of ours.

note.smugglers.note: Writer 2026-10-15 (UNDER-05): smugglers' voice; hints Ford cellar + crypt (scraped names), no spoilers.
note.smugglers.title: A note under a crate
lines: Low tide only. By high water this floor is sea.
Salt and oil go to the cellar under the Ford.
Nothing more goes by the graves. Not after dark.
Names off the walls down there. We never did that.

note.fordMark.title: A mark cut in the base
lines: Three rings and a line through them.
The same mark as the stones under the Wards.
The ones that hum.

note.owBoard.title: Notices, nailed up
lines: Crown notices, printed in Ferrum. Rain-soft.
FELL BEYOND THE WALL. Name after name.
Carried out here and nailed up, one by one.
One line cut away. On the nail, a skyworks knot.

note.pierStone.title: A standing stone
lines: A dressed block, set on end beside the track.
Old mortar on one face. Once part of a bridge pier.
A Crown stamp, half chiselled away.
The bridge was pulled down. Not by the river.

note.stoneKnot.title: A knot at the stone's foot
lines: A cord tied round a root at the stone's foot.
A lamp-trimmer's hitch, old and grey.
Whoever tied it knew the stone by name.
